full_judgment: "I have perused the material on record and it is found that the trial Court has not considered all the aspects of the case in decreeing the suit But the appellate Court has considered the materials part of the statements for the witnesses, the deed of above 80 years, old, possession on the suit property and the opposite parties recording of their names in S.A. and R.S. Khatian. I have also observed the discussion referred by the learned Counsels of both the parties. On considering the above materials and document I am of the view that the appellate Court has passed a sound Judgment and decree and I have little scope to interfere and as such the rule has no merit."
